original.statement: The Redis provider static option tls.caOptional was removed in v3 and should be removed from configuration.

corrected.statement: The Redis provider static configuration option providers.redis.tls.caOptional has been removed in Traefik v3, because TLS client authentication is a server-side option.

decision.reason: [ev-9f184d231baf] says the Redis provider `tls.CAOptional` option "has been removed in v3". Its static configuration example spells the key `providers.redis.tls.caOptional`, so a config-key subject with change type `removed` is right. The component "redis-provider" is a made-up spelling and not a file or binary. The full path already identifies the Redis provider, so component should not be set.
